requirement: Review a treatment plan: the plan must exist and be live, and only a plan in the NotAdhere state may be reviewed once, after which its adherence state becomes the review state (NotAdhereValid or NotAdhereInvalid) and the Updated status is returned.

preconditions.text: A live treatment plan exists for the target id
The plan is currently NotAdhere and has not been reviewed
The plan is unknown, soft-deleted, already reviewed, or not NotAdhere

inputs.text: ReviewTreatmentPlan AdherePlan Fail (seededState: Adhere, reviewState: NotAdhereInvalid)
ReviewTreatmentPlan AdherePlan Fail (seededState: Adhere, reviewState: NotAdhereValid)
ReviewTreatmentPlan AlreadyReviewedPlan Fail (seededState: NotAdhereInvalid, reviewState: NotAdhereValid)
ReviewTreatmentPlan AlreadyReviewedPlan Fail (seededState: NotAdhereValid, reviewState: NotAdhereInvalid)

returns.text: Success with Updated status and the review state applied
Failure with BadRequest for an unknown or soft-deleted plan
Failure with BadRequest when the plan is already reviewed or is Adhere

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
